description: This file defines a utility function 'getTimeRangeDisplay' that formats time ranges for display, based on whether a custom date range is used or a relative time window such as last minute, hour, or days. It is part of the UI components related to logging in the application.

methods.name: getTimeRangeDisplay
methods.description: Formats time range display strings based on whether a custom date range is used or a relative time window, utilizing moment.js for date manipulation.
